name: infrastructure
postCreateCommand: apk update && apk add git bash curl wget python3 ansible unzip && curl -LO https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/${TERRAFORM_VERSION}/terraform_${TERRAFORM_VERSION}_linux_amd64.zip && unzip terraform_${TERRAFORM_VERSION}_linux_amd64.zip -d /usr/local/bin && rm terraform_${TERRAFORM_VERSION}_linux_amd64.zip && terraform -version
